title: Unit Event — The Way I Played That Day — Episode8 The Way I Played That Day

meta.Event: The Way I Played That Day
meta.Episode: Episode8 — The Way I Played That Day
meta.Event Outline: Kanade continues to write songs in the hope of saving Mafuyu. When her grandmother calls to suggest that she think more about herself and her own future, her thoughts turn toward the past.

rows.Line: A few days later
Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Rin?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I'm wondering if Kanade's okay.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. She visited a little while ago...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, she said she was feeling better, but I'm still a little worried...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, you're here.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, hello. Mafuyu and the others should also be arriving shortly since I'll have them listen to the new demo today...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But before they come, there's a song I'd like for you all to hear...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? Us?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I'll play it now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It feels a little different from your usual songs, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
I agree...
Normally, I'd feel warm and light after my chest tightened up a little.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But this one feels so happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I took some time to think a little after we last spoke...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: All that joy I felt back then is never coming back, and I can't change what happened to my dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm okay with at least asking myself, “What if there's a way?”

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: So, I composed a song based on what I felt when I worked on my very first song...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I don't plan on uploading it online since it feels a little too happy in terms of N25.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But... I really like this song.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'd be a shame if no one else gets to hear it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, so you should have Mafuyu and the others also listen to it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh? Kanade, you're already here?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What were you guys talking about?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, um. So...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: There's a song I'd like for you all to listen to.
A few hours later
Hospital Room

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry for running a little late today, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How do you feel? It's been getting chilly lately. I bought this sweater for you since it seemed warm. I hope you get a chance to wear it sometime.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, Dad, do you remember when I composed a song by myself for the very first time...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I tried composing one based on what I felt back then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It probably feels a little different to the songs I'm composing now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I made this one in the hopes that you'd remember how happy you and Mom were back then...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: The thing is, Dad...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Ever since that day, I've been trying to compose songs that make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I still can't do what you were able to, Dad, but there is someone who really needs my songs now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She's in a really tough situation at the moment, which is why I'm going to keep trying to save her...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I can do that... If I can make others happy...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Maybe, I can be even a little bit as good a composer as you...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
And if I can do that...
Maybe you'll remember who I am.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And then, like the way things used to be...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
I hope you pat my head...
And praise me for not giving up all this time.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Even for just a moment...
If it means regaining...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I probably have no right wishing for something like this.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I think it's okay for me to right now...)
